title: Evidence Package
description: Schema for the canonical evidence package envelope emitted by compose-dashboard. The framework's central architectural claim is that this JSON envelope IS the product; markdown reports, HTML dashboards, PowerPoint decks, and decision memos are all *renderings* of an instance of this schema. See plan § Target Dashboard Architecture § Evidence package IS the product (A3) and § compose-dashboard behavioral spec (B1) for the runtime semantics that produce instances. This schema validates the runtime-emitted artifact; it does NOT validate authoring surfaces (those live in card.schema.json and dashboard_spec.schema.json).

package_id.description: Stable identifier for this specific evidence package emission. Convention: ep-{target}-{indication}-{release_pin}-{data_mode}-{seq}.

framework_version.description: Semver of the framework that emitted this package. Iter-1 ships 2.0.0.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of emission. Non-deterministic; excluded from card-invariance equality checks.

generated_by.description: Skill identifier + git_sha that emitted this package (e.g., 'skills/compose-dashboard@a1b2c3d').

context.description: The (target, indication, scope, subgroup_spec) binding this package was emitted for.

subgroup_spec.description: Either a list of subgroup_ids, the string 'all', or null.

governance.description: Governance metadata: data mode, release pin, lockfile reference, concurrence record reference, validation summary. The block downstream renderers consult to decide whether to emit into a nomination-grade artifact.

data_mode.description: Must match data_mode.enum.yaml; inlined for standalone validation.

lockfile_ref.description: Relative path to lockfile.yaml within the package directory.

concurrence.description: Optional concurrence-record reference. Absent for exploratory-mode packages or for packages not yet reviewed.

dashboard_spec_ref.description: Reference to the dashboard_spec used to compose this package (e.g., 'target-contracts/dashboards/target-in-indication.dashboard_spec.yaml@<git_sha>').

cards.description: Per-card outputs. Each entry is ONE of: (1) a present-and-validated card (card_present — summary, interpretation_call, provenance); (2) an applies_when exclusion stub (card_excluded — a structured predicate reason); (3) an availability stub (card_unavailable — the card produced no usable signal, carrying a typed availability_state that says WHY: not_wired / data_blocked / read_error / insufficient). card_unavailable replaces the historical silent drop-to-n_cards_failed: an unwired or data-blocked card is now a first-class, reasoned absence a consumer can key on, not an opaque integer. Validation-FAILED cards (method exception / schema violation) still do NOT appear here — they are surfaced only in validation_report.json (A2 rule).

synthesis.description: Output of the dashboard_spec's synthesis_prompts. Iter-1 ships a minimal synthesis (headline + caveats_summary); deeper synthesis is iter-2.

renderings.description: References to rendered surfaces produced for this package. Iter-1 ships markdown only.

validation_state.description: Present-card entries are pass or passed_with_warnings. Failed cards do NOT appear in the envelope.

summary.description: The card's emitted summary fields. Shape varies per card_id (matches the card_spec's outputs.summary_fields).

figures.description: Figure descriptors emitted by phase-2's figure-emission registry. Path is relative to the evidence package's output root.

interpretation_call.description: The interpretation label emitted by the card's first-matching interpretation_hints rule. For negative-control runs, expect values like 'not informative' or 'no characterized hotspot landscape'.

warning_ids.description: Structured warning identifiers fired by the card's warning_predicates (when validation_state is passed_with_warnings). Free-text warnings are NOT acceptable; see validation_state.enum.yaml.passed_with_warnings.requires_structured_warning_ids.

canonical_decision_refs.description: References to canonical-decisions records (resolves open item #8). Required for governance-grade packages.

excluded_by_applies_when.description: Discriminator: distinguishes excluded entries from card_present entries.

exclusion_reason.description: Structured reason: the applies_when predicate (or cascading-exclusion link) that failed. NOT free text — must reference the failed predicate.

card_unavailable.description: A card that produced NO usable signal, carrying a typed reason WHY. Replaces the historical silent drop-to-n_cards_failed: an unwired / data-blocked / errored / measured-absent card is a first-class reasoned absence, so a consumer (and the deciding-axis router) can distinguish 'we haven't built it' from 'we looked and it's genuinely unknown'. Discriminator: `availability_state` present (card_present has validation_state; card_excluded has excluded_by_applies_when).

availability_state.description: WHY the card is unavailable. See vocabularies/availability_state.enum.yaml. not_wired/data_blocked/read_error are framework-COVERAGE gaps (never looked / could not look); insufficient is a MEASURED gap (looked, target genuinely absent / below floor). None is opposing evidence.

availability_reason.description: Human-readable, structured reason string (e.g. 'dispatcher_returned_none', 'live_read_error: <detail>', 'primary_class=data_unavailable'). Names the concrete cause; not free-form narrative.
